messages:
Maya: Quick poll — what's your go-to 2-hour couch binge for a rainy Saturday? Could be music + movie/TV/book. I'm building a 'cozy loop' playlist + watchlist, drop recs!
Raj: Only Murders in the Building for light mystery + easy laughs. :popcorn:
Oliver: Movie rec — Before Sunrise. Perfect low-key chatty energy.
Jen: Book rec: The Night Circus. Transporting and weirdly cozy.
Sam: Music rec — my 'harbour afternoons' playlist: ```https://open.spotify.com/playlist/placeholder``` mostly instrumental, acoustic, lo-fi.
EchoBot: FYI: free pizza in the kitchen at 4pm, may influence evening plans. :pizza:
Maya: Love these. @Raj adding OMITB. @Sam can you paste the playlist link (non-fenced) so people can save?
Sam: Sure — https://open.spotify.com/playlist/7CozyLoop (public, curated for rainy days). Also toss 'Ramy' in for a different tone.
Raj: :heart: for TV night.
Oliver: Detectorists for a very gentle TV option — slow pace but oddly comforting.
Jen: Film rec: Paterson if you want a movie that's basically a calm mood piece.
Maya: Micro poll: react with :heart: for TV, :book: for book, :film_projector: for movie, :musical_note: for music. I'll tally in 10 mins.
Raj: :heart:
Sam: :musical_note:
Oliver: :heart:
Jen: :book:
Sam: :musical_note:
Maya: Quick tally — :heart: x2 (TV), :musical_note: x2 (music), :book: x1 (book), :film_projector: x0 (movie). Looks like split between TV night and playlist. Planning to put together a 2-hour cozy loop mix + a short watchlist doc and drop it here later.
Raj: Nice! Maybe pair OMITB ep1 + a 45-min mellow playlist chunk.
Maya: Will do. Thanks all — keep recs coming if you think of anything else. :sparkles:
